answer_1.quote: We propose Ask Patients with Patience (APP), a new LLM-based clinical dialogue model designed for grounded reasoning and human-centric interactions.

answer_2.quote: We use entropy as a quantitative measure to assess diagnostic confidence and interpretability.

answer_4.quote: We invited three experts, each with over five years of biomedical experience, to evaluate the quality of the predicted diagnoses.
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated predictions using a 5-point scale reflecting alignment with ground truth. A score of 0 indicates no relevance, while a score of 5 denotes an exact match. Experts also assessed trustworthiness, alignment with guidelines, information gathering, clarity, and relationship support. Non-medical participants rated accessibility, empathy, relevant response rate, and relationship fostering on a 1–5 scale.
